name: Ozem
overview: Ozem is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the sixth-born son of Jesse. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, serving to situate him within the lineage of a significant biblical family. There are no additional notes or detailed narratives about his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Ozem appears as a proper name in Scripture without any provided meaning or divine origin. It is simply recorded as the personal name of this individual, with no further explanation or title attached.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Ozem as a son of Jesse, making him part of the family from which King David emerged. Beyond this filial relationship, no other family connections or relationships are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Ozem's significance lies in his place within the genealogy of Judah, highlighting the lineage of Jesse's sons. While not a prominent character in biblical narratives, his inclusion helps preserve the historical and familial context critical to understanding the heritage of David and the Messianic line. This genealogical mention underscores the faithfulness of God's providence in preserving His chosen family.
